verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is community discussion. One thread cites GPT-5.5 scoring 82.7% on Terminal Bench, a third-party benchmark, and compares it with other models near ~80%. An OpenAI employee mentions relying on third-party published evals, though that remark concerns competitors' models. There is no direct evidence of GPT appearing on independent, third-party-run leaderboards; the Terminal Bench score may itself be vendor-reported. Missing for 10: documented presence on independent leaderboards (e.g. third-party-run rankings), independently run evaluation results rather than vendor-reported benchmark numbers, and links to third-party eval sources.
